description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLogAPI class which provides an API endpoint for retrieving action logs associated with a specific timesheet in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching paginated, sortable data with validation rules.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogAPI
